review_basis: source-review.md; exact captured XML and prepared text
assessment: Manual source-supported labels; revisable, not gold. Do not include in model requests.
credit_rule: At least one complete additional focus meaning per case. It must appear in the primary statement of a focus unit, retain its conditions and have exact source support. An isolated context-only statement, extra term label, retained bare citation, or available source alone is not a gain. Record each arm and observation separately.
critical_regression: New unsupported or incorrect actor, modality, scope or exception decision relative to its paired baseline, including false inheritance from neighboring definitions or editorial history. Report omissions and other losses separately too.
